result.reasoning: This commit ("Fix IllegalStateException in DownloadWizardProvider") introduced the logic of storing and restoring mouseTransparent state on `previousNode` via a MOUSE_TRANSPARENT property key, and setting `previousNode.setMouseTransparent(true)` during transition. The fix commit (2324af649c2c) removes this exact mechanism and instead sets mouseTransparent on the whole `view`, indicating the bug (setting mouse transparency on the wrong node/scope) originated in 3fb5048f103e. Subsequent commit e9db183d545b only wrapped this logic in Platform.runLater without changing the core buggy semantics.
